notes.text: Shabbat has Rav Huna bar Chalov asking Rav Nachman, as in [Heilprin’s Huna notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=979&lang=en).
Chullin reads Rabbi Yitzchak ben Chalov. Hyman and [Heilprin’s Yitzchak notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2181&lang=en) write bar Chalov.
